barRaise.topFinding: The release pipeline is unblocked. collect-usage.ps1:867 now reads the queue through an explicit UTF8 ReadAllText instead of a cp1252-default Get-Content, the double-encoded em dash is gone from dashboard/data/queue.json, and check-status-json.ps1 exits 0, so release.ps1 clears Step 1/4. That was the only breakage signal, so the verdict moves to working for the first time in eighteen runs. What did not move is the public surface: /.work-queue.json (797 KB), /.work-queue-archive.json (1,042 KB), a corrupt queue snapshot and the .work-queue-results/ tree all return HTTP 200, and robots.txt carries no work-queue entry at all. The morning canonical audit corrected the fix and caught a real trap: the previous run's action to git rm --cached all tracked artifacts would have destroyed the only backup of the live queue. Untrack the 70 disposable ones and drop the two backup-bearing files from the Pages artifact instead.
